Flights: Delta Nonstop New York (JFK) to Catania (CTA)

Separate from the stay prices. Flights are not included in any stay total above.

Catania (CTA) is the airport for Taormina, about a 50-60 minute drive.

  • Outbound: Delta DL 244, JFK 4:45 PM → CTA 7:55 AM next day (9 hr 10 min, Boeing 767). Leave the day before check-in.
  • Return: Delta DL 245, CTA 9:55 AM → JFK 2:20 PM same day (10 hr 25 min, Boeing 767).
  • Seasonal route: on sale for Aug 28 – Sep 22, 2027 (no return flights found in early October).
